newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 42-day CDs draw 14.02 pct avg yield at sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru 42-day CDs draw 14.02 pct avg yield at sale.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Wednesday it accepted bids for 42-day certificates of deposit (CDs) worth 43.1 million soles during an auction BCQZ.
The CDs, which carry an effective average annual interest rate of 14.02 percent, have an October 10 starting date.
The accepted bids had a minimum rate of 13.95 percent and a maximum rate also of 14.14 percent.
At the last auction on October 3, 31-day CDs drew an average yield of 14.03 percent.
At Wednesday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 77.1 million soles.
The bank had offered 40 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
